Reached unsupported XSD, value, identity or DTD capabilities remain incomplete; unread external subsets, including the official score examples, cannot be accepted. Excludes timeline/effective state, broader context/intent, repeats/spans, time-only ordering, linked resources, packages, external dictionaries and remaining normative translations. Score-only clauses are inapplicable to opus, not claims about linked opus content. Predicate-instance counts are not research-record coverage or complete MusicXML conformance.

profile.NormativeClosure: Explicit bounded MusicXML 4.0 source or current-model XSD, local clauses and shared exact musical timeline/effective-state assessment. The timeline provider finalizes typed part/measure/event and state evidence; its pass does not assert that every optional or ambiguous musical fact is known. The selected mandatory consumers are principal-note chord duration bounds and explicit numeral-key or applicable encoded effective-key presence at the harmony's unshifted score origin. Ordinary exact rational positions are not rounded. Ambiguous, missing, invalid or unsupported dependent evidence remains incomplete. Existing target-specific XSD, current-model representation, source syntax and unread external-DTD limits remain active. Broader repeat/span/intent/layout/playback consumers, packages, linked scores, external dictionaries and remaining normative closure are excluded. Opus selection assesses only that document, never linked scores. Counts are selected predicate instances, not complete MusicXML coverage.

profile.NormativeClosure: Explicit bounded MusicXML 4.0 source or current-model XSD/local/timeline and contextual assessment. New sealed context families produce independently owned typed scalar/default, span, graphical-repeat, navigation, layout and timing evidence. A completed provider means extraction/projection finished; it does not assert every optional fact or ambiguous correspondence is known. Mandatory consumers compare numerical time-only order, release sign for established bend gestures, and proved graphical-repeat content. Equal-adjacent passes, unresolved musical-content equivalence, and the unreviewed figure-number numeric grammar remain explicitly incomplete. Type-specific identity, presence, applicability, causal unavailability and exact values are preserved without a universal span-balance, meter-fill or rendering requirement. Source/current-model representation and unread external-DTD limits remain active. Unproved author intent, playback realization, application geometry, ambiguous navigation policies and precise unresolved source clauses retain bounded unavailable evidence. Packages, linked resources, external dictionaries and transitive normative closure remain excluded. Opus assessment projects only local score pagination hints, preserves application-dependent absence, and never follows linked scores. Rule and fact counts are not MusicXML coverage denominators.
